files.description: Manifest V3 declaration: permissions, host permissions, service worker, popup, icons.
npm scripts for validation, tests, doc index checks, and packaging. Zero dependencies.
Path-validates the documentation retrieval indexes; --prune removes dead entries.
Builds the Chrome Web Store archive from only the files Chrome loads.
Validates manifest shape, referenced files, icon PNG signatures and real pixel dimensions, and absence of Manifest V2 keys.
MV3 service worker. Owns all network and tab work; runs the direct-download and transcript-panel strategies; message contract with the popup.
Injected transcript-panel reader. Handles both YouTube markup generations plus a structural fallback. The most fragile file in the repo.
Dependency-free PDF 1.4 writer: toWinAnsi, wrapText, buildTranscriptPdf, toSafeFilename. Helvetica AFM metrics, verified xref table.
Pure caption parsing and formatting: parseJson3, parseTimedTextXml, parseCaptions, formatTimestamp, groupIntoParagraphs, renderText.
Pure YouTube URL parsing and watch-page scraping: parseVideoId, parseWatchPage, pickTrack, extractJsonVar, watchUrl.
Popup styles with light and dark palettes.
Popup markup. Module script only, no inline handlers.
Popup controller: prefill, fetch, preview, PDF download, print handoff, clipboard, persisted options.
Printable viewer. Reads a one-shot payload from session storage, deletes it, renders for Chrome print-to-PDF.
11 tests: transliteration, word wrap, PDF structural validity including byte-accurate xref offsets, pagination, filenames.
8 tests: json3 and XML parsing, empty bodies, timestamps, paragraph grouping, render options.
12 tests: URL shapes, hostname allowlist, watch-page parsing, fallbacks, parsed flag, track selection.
